arxiv-2212-10076.title: Out-of-sample scoring and automatic selection of causal estimators
arxiv-2212-10076.creator: Egor Kraev, Timo Flesch, Hudson Taylor Lekunze, Mark Harley, Pere Planell Morell
arxiv-2212-10076.description: Abstract Recently, many causal estimators for Conditional Average Treatment Effect (CATE) and instrumental variable (IV) problems have been published and open sourced, allowing to estimate granular impact of both randomized treatments (such as A/B tests) and of user choices on the outcomes of interest.

arxiv-2303-14329.title: Edge-Based Video Analytics: A Survey
arxiv-2303-14329.creator: Miao Hu 1 , Zhenxiao Luo 2 , Amirmohammad Pasdar 3 , Young Choon Lee 4 , Yipeng Zhou 5 and Di Wu 6
arxiv-2303-14329.description: Abstract Edge computing has been getting a momentum with ever-increasing data at the edge of the network. In particular, huge amounts of video data and their real-time processing requirements have been increasingly hindering the traditional cloud computing approach due to high bandwidth consumption and high latency.

arxiv-2310-00131.title: Event-Triggered Control of Neuron Growth with Actuation at Soma
arxiv-2310-00131.creator: Cenk Demir, Shumon Koga, Miroslav Krstic
arxiv-2310-00131.description: Abstract We introduce a dynamic event-triggering mechanism for regulating the axonal growth of a neuron. We apply boundary actuation at the soma (the part of a neuron that contains the nucleus) and regulate the dynamics of tubulin concentration and axon length.

arxiv-2403-10704.title: Parameter Efficient Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
arxiv-2403-10704.creator: Hakim Sidahmed, Samrat Phatale, Alex Hutcheson, Zhuonan Lin, Zhang Chen, Zac Yu, Jarvis Jin, Simral Chaudhary, Roman Komarytsia, Christiane Ahlheim, Yonghao Zhu, Bowen Li, Saravanan Ganesh, Bill Byrne, Jessica Hoffmann, Hassan Mansoor, Wei Li, Abhinav Rastogi, Lucas Dixon
arxiv-2403-10704.description: Abstract While Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) effectively aligns pretrained Large Language and Vision-Language Models (LLMs, and VLMs) with human preferences, its computational cost and complexity hamper its wider adoption. To alleviate some of the computational burden of fine-tuning, parameter efficient methods, like LoRA ( Hu et al. 2021 ) were introduced.

arxiv-2509-09976.title: Impact of Disorder on the Superconducting Properties and BCS-BEC Crossover in FeSe Single Crystals Preprint: Sun/Anisotropy of FeTeSe
arxiv-2509-09976.creator: Jianping Fu, Yue Sun, Jingting Chen, Zhixiang Shi, Tsuyoshi Tamegai
arxiv-2509-09976.description: Abstract We investigate the crystal structure, transport properties and specific heat in five selected FeSe single crystals containing different amounts of disorder. Transport measurements show that disorder significantly suppresses superconducting transition temperature, T c T_{\mathrm{c}} , and upper critical field, H c2 H_{\mathrm{c2}} .

arxiv-2511-13819.title: Chow polynomials of rank-uniform labeled posets
arxiv-2511-13819.creator: Basile Coron, Luis Ferroni, Shiyue Li
arxiv-2511-13819.description: Abstract . We introduce and develop the theory of UMEL-shellable posets. These are posets equipped with an edge-lexicographical labeling satisfying certain uniformity and monotonicity properties. This framework encompasses classical families of combinatorial geometries, including uniform matroids, projective and affine geometries, braid matroids of type A and B, and all Dowling geometries.

pmc-11435989.title: Applications of Artificial Intelligence for Heat Stress Management in Ruminant Livestock
pmc-11435989.creator: Ebenezer Binuni Rebez, Veerasamy Sejian, Mullakkalparambil Velayudhan Silpa, Gajendirane Kalaignazhal, Duraisamy Thirunavukkarasu, Chinnasamy Devaraj, Kumar Tej Nikhil, Jacob Ninan, Artabandhu Sahoo, Nicola Lacetera, Frank Rowland Dunshea
pmc-11435989.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Heat stress impacts ruminant livestock production on varied levels in this alarming climate breakdown scenario. The drastic effects of the global climate change-associated heat stress in ruminant livestock demands constructive evaluation of animal performance bordering on effective monitoring systems. In this climate-smart digital age, adoption of advanced and developing Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies is gaining traction for efficient heat stress management.

pmc-11453448.title: 7078 Diagnostic Obstacles in Thyroid-Stimulating Hormone-Secreting Pituitary Adenoma (TSH-oma): A Case Report
pmc-11453448.creator: Vaidehi Alkeshbhai Mendpara, Pratibha P R Rao, Michelle D Lundholm
pmc-11453448.description: Disclosure: V.A. Mendpara: None. P.P. Rao: None. M.D. Lundholm: None. Background: Thyroid-stimulating hormone-secreting pituitary adenoma (TSH-oma) is a rare cause of hyperthyroidism, forming 0.5-3% of all functioning pituitary tumors and <1% of hyperthyroid cases. Here, TSH secretion is autonomous and unresponsive to the normal negative feedback of thyroid hormones, leading to inappropriate TSH, T4 and T3 elevation.

pmc-12554049.title: Improving calcium bioavailability from fish bone waste: the role of sodium hydroxide in bio‑calcium extraction from tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) bones
pmc-12554049.creator: Theeraphol Senphan, Natthapong Mungmueang, Vachira Choommongkol, Chodsana Sriket, Hideki Kishimura, Phanat Kittiphattanabawon, Soottawat Benjakul
pmc-12554049.description: Calcium deficiency is a global health issue motivating the search for sustainable calcium sources from aquaculture waste. This study investigated sodium hydroxide (NaOH) concentration effects on bio‑calcium quality and bioavailability extracted from tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) bones. Tilapia bones were treated with 0.5 M, 1 M, and 2 M NaOH solutions for 30 min compared to untreated controls.

pmc-12560921.title: The Economics of Animal Health: A 25-Year Bibliometric Analysis
pmc-12560921.creator: Arzu Peker, Şükrü Orkan, Luisa Magrin, Severino Segato, Clive J C Phillips
pmc-12560921.description: Simple SummaryAnimal diseases not only cause suffering among animals but also very often result in huge economic problems for farmers and society. They can reduce productivity, restrict trade, and impose extra costs on governments and consumers. Understanding these economic outcomes is crucial for creating effective policies and enhancing global animal health.

pmc-12630312.title: A Machine Learning Tool to Predict Survival After First Surgery in Peripheral Artery Disease Patients
pmc-12630312.creator: Martina Doneda, Ettore Lanzarone, Fabio Riccardo Pisa, Bianca Pane, Giovanni Pratesi, Giovanni Spinella
pmc-12630312.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The aim of this study was to develop and validate a machine learning tool for predicting survival in PAD patients who received surgical treatment. We used the data from 1,615 patients who underwent PAD surgery from 2005 to 2020. Gradient boosted decision trees (GBDTs) were used to predict mortality at one, three and five years after the first surgery, while predictor importance was assessed using the SHAP values method.

pmc-13139632.title: Characterization of the Orphan Cytochrome P450 CYP107J1 From Bacillus subtilis Through Peroxygenase Activity Engineering
pmc-13139632.creator: Hideki Kato, Takafumi Hashimoto, Tuhin Das, Daniel Z. Doherty, Stephen G. Bell, Toshiki Furuya
pmc-13139632.description: Cytochrome P450 monooxygenases (P450s) not only play many physiological roles in oxidative metabolism but are also promising biocatalysts for the synthesis of organic molecules. Bacillus subtilis strain 168, which possesses eight P450 genes, has been extensively studied as a model bacterium, but the catalytic function of CYP107J1 remains to be fully elucidated. Here, we investigated the catalytic function of CYP107J1.

pmc-13261243.description: BackgroundIn SANTORINI, one-third of patients achieved low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) goals at 1-year follow-up, with oral combination therapies used in approximately 38 %. pmc-13317379.creator: Jing Zhang, Zhinan Ren, Lei Yu, Cheng Peng, Yingjie Hao
pmc-13317379.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo compare the short-term clinical efficacy of percutaneous endoscopic transforaminal discectomy (PETD) with that of unilateral biportal endoscopy (UBE) in the treatment of upper lumbar disc herniation (ULDH).MethodsClinical data from 109 consecutive hospitalized patients who were diagnosed with ULDH and admitted to the Department of Orthopaedics, The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, from February 2021 to February 2024 were retrospectively analysed.

pmc-13367970.title: The splice of life: an isoform-centric view of disease, technology, and therapeutics
pmc-13367970.creator: Timothy Pan, Lina Lu, Ruli Gao
pmc-13367970.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Alternative splicing is a pervasive mechanism that expands the coding potential and functional complexity of the human genome. Dysregulated isoform usage alters gene functions and contributes broadly to human disease across developmental, neurodegenerative, and cancer settings. Technologies for characterizing splicing and isoforms have advanced rapidly, evolving from Sanger sequencing of individual cDNA clones to high-throughput next-generation sequencing of splice junctions, and more recently to long-read sequencing that resolves full-length transcripts at bulk, single-cell, and spatial resolutions.
